description: Client-side script defining the ItemQuickEntryForm class for quick item entry in ERPNext, extending QuickEntryForm with methods for rendering dialogs, handling variants, attributes, and form submission.

classes.name: ItemQuickEntryForm
classes.description: A class extending QuickEntryForm for quick entry of items with variant and attribute handling.

methods.name: render_dialog
methods.description: Prepares and renders the item quick entry dialog, including variant and attribute fields.

methods.name: check_naming_series_based_on
methods.description: Adjusts mandatory fields based on naming series defaults.

methods.name: init_post_render_dialog_operations
methods.description: Initializes post-render operations like appending templates and toggling manufacturer fields.

methods.name: register_primary_action
methods.description: Sets up the primary save action for the dialog, handling variant creation and insertion.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new item variant document via API call and updates the form accordingly.

methods.name: open_doc
methods.description: Opens the item form route based on the current dialog state.

methods.name: get_variant_fields
methods.description: Returns configuration for variant creation fields.

methods.name: get_manufacturing_fields
methods.description: Returns manufacturing-related fields, hidden by default.

methods.name: get_attributes_fields
methods.description: Returns attribute-related fields combined with manufacturing fields.

methods.name: init_for_create_variant_trigger
methods.description: Sets up click handler for create variant checkbox.

methods.name: preset_fields_for_template
methods.description: Adjusts form fields based on whether creating a variant.

methods.name: init_for_item_template_trigger
methods.description: Sets onchange handler for item template selection, fetching item details.

methods.name: init_post_template_trigger_operations
methods.description: Initializes attribute rendering and manufacturer toggle based on template.

methods.name: toggle_manufacturer_fields
methods.description: Shows or hides manufacturer fields based on context.

methods.name: initiate_render_attributes
methods.description: Renders attribute controls in the dialog.

methods.name: render_attributes
methods.description: Creates UI controls for item attributes, including autocomplete and validation.

methods.name: init_make_control
methods.description: Creates a form control for an attribute.

methods.name: init_awesomplete_for_attribute
methods.description: Sets up autocomplete for attribute input.

methods.name: get_variant_doc
methods.description: Generates a variant document based on selected attributes.

methods.name: validate_mandatory_attributes
methods.description: Validates and collects attribute values, including manufacturer info.
